name: core.openwop.workflows.campaign-channels
description: The five campaign channel child workflows (ADR 0157) — generate→approve→publish DAGs the orchestration fans out over — migrated from the deprecated builtins (ADR 0472 P4). chainIds keep the original ids. v1.5.0 (user decision 2026-11-19): an approved draft is created in the real tool. Landing page → a draft CMS page, email sequence → draft email campaigns, ad variants → a PAUSED campaign when an ad account is given, else a draft ad-copy document, social posts → a draft social-calendar document. Creative briefs keep create-creative-briefs. A rejected or skipped channel creates nothing.

chains.label: Landing page
chains.description: Generate a campaign landing page from the brief, approve it, then create it as a draft CMS page.

briefId.description: The campaign brief to generate this channel from.

provider.description: AI provider id for this chain's model-calling nodes (for example anthropic, openai, google). Fixed into those nodes when the workflow is created. Leave unset to keep the nodes' own default.

model.description: Model id for this chain's model-calling nodes. Must be offered by `provider` in the host catalog. Set it together with `provider`.

producedVariables.name: channelResult
producedVariables.description: This channel's result, {channel, draft} or {channel, skipped, reason}; an orchestration maps it out (ADR 1020 D2).

config.prompt: Review the generated landing page. Approve it to create it as a draft page in your CMS (nothing is published); reject it to discard it.

inputs.summary: Skipped: this brief does not enable the landing page channel, so nothing was generated.

chains.label: Ad variants
chains.description: Generate ad variants per platform, approve them, then create the campaign PAUSED on the ad platform, or a draft ad-copy document when no ad account is given (ADR 0167).

briefId.description: The campaign brief to generate this channel from.

provider.description: AI provider id for this chain's model-calling nodes (for example anthropic, openai, google). Fixed into those nodes when the workflow is created. Leave unset to keep the nodes' own default.

model.description: Model id for this chain's model-calling nodes. Must be offered by `provider` in the host catalog. Set it together with `provider`.

adAccountId.description: The ad account to create the campaign in, PAUSED. Leave it unset to create a draft ad-copy document instead.

platform.description: The ad platform: meta (the default), google, tiktok or linkedin.

pageId.description: Meta only, and required there: the Facebook Page the ads run from.

identityId.description: TikTok only, and required there: the identity the ads run as.

landingUrl.description: The landing URL the ads link to. Required for Google. It is stamped with the brief's UTM parameters.

euPoliticalAdvertising.description: Google only: your declaration that the campaign does_not_contain or contains EU political advertising. Never filled in for you.

producedVariables.name: channelResult
producedVariables.description: This channel's result, {channel, draft} or {channel, skipped, reason}; an orchestration maps it out (ADR 1020 D2).

config.prompt: Review the generated ad variants. Approve them to create the campaign PAUSED in your ad account (no spend until you activate it), or a draft ad-copy document when no ad account is set; reject them to discard them.

inputs.summary: Skipped: this brief does not enable the ad variants channel, so nothing was generated.
